name: ebb-ai — carbon-aware deferral
description: Auto-defer "do it later" tasks to the cleanest electricity-grid hour inside the deadline.

dbPath.description: Override the SQLite queue path. Defaults to ~/.ebb-ai/queue.db (shared with the @ebb-ai/mcp server and @ebb-ai/cli).

defaultRegion.description: Default electricity-grid region when a tool call omits one. Examples: GB, US-CAL-CISO, FR. Defaults to GB (always-live data, no API key needed).
